subject: Kickoff: Dream Fields 3D asset demo
body:
Team,

Kicking off the Dream Fields effort for vision. The method from our open-source release generates 3D object geometry and color from a text prompt alone — no 3D supervision — by optimizing a NeRF so that renders from many camera views score highly against the caption under a pre-trained CLIP model, with sparsity-inducing transmittance regularization and scene bounds keeping the geometry clean.

Product target: an internal demo where a designer types a prompt and gets a usable textured mesh for prototyping. The creative-tools group is the sponsor.

Milestones: reproduce release quality in our environment by mid-May (the NGC-container Docker path should make this quick), quality/latency improvements through June, demo assets and Launch Review Board submission early July.

Deshawn follows up on staffing, compute, and the data-platform dependency for the caption set.

Lucia
